notes.title: Update 1.29
notes.notes: In this update, we fixed an issue where players might not have all resolution options available in the game settings.

notes.title: Update 1.27
notes.notes:
In this update we have removed the lags that could occur at the beginning and end of cutscenes.

Now everything is finally fine :)

notes.title: Update 1.25
notes.notes:
Hi there!

In our update 1.25, we added support for new Nvidia technologies, including DLSS 4, as well as updated versions of Frame Generation and Reflex.

We also fixed the errors that users reported to us.

Thanks to everyone who helps us find flaws in our game! We read every comment and try to make the game better for you.

After the release of the update, we are getting back to work on our new co-op project. We will be happy to share details about it in the coming months.

Take care and see you soon!

notes.title: UPD 2024-09-09
notes.notes:
We are constantly studying the feedback from our players, so in this update, we added additional hints regarding the gameplay and made optimizations to the lighting, allowing you to play more smoothly and comfortably.

notes.notes: Small fix related to performance issues.

notes.title: UPD 2024-09-02 (minor fix)
notes.notes: Changed the resolution settings to improve the performance.

notes.title: UPD 2024-09-01 (anti-aliasing and optimisation)
notes.notes:
1. The ability to select an anti-aliasing method has been added to the settings so that you can fine-tune the image depending on the characteristics of your computer.

2. Minor optimization works have been carried out.

notes.title: UPD 2024-08-31 (debug messages fix + interaction update)
notes.notes:
Fixed debug messages display.
Added ghost of items to be placed and highlighted most of interactive objects.

notes.title: UPD 2024-08-31 (map fix)
